title: #974 partial: test isolation proven live, SemRepo gone, OpenAlex unlanded
body: Core demand verified live on 3.15t: 119 tests across test_learning_worms.py and test_db_monitor_worm.py left the production store at exactly 382842 rows (before == after), proving the conftest AZAZAEL_MEMORY_DIR redirect holds. SemRepo has zero references across src, tests, tools, and scripts (retired by absence). OpenAlex is still unlanded: src/CORE/openalex_integration.py does not exist though orkg_integration.py cites it as an existing pattern; landing it is open work for the owning lane.
